## Research internships

I take a small number of research interns each year, usually undergraduate or postgraduate students in computer science, data science, economics or management, working remotely or at MSE, Chennai.

**Applied machine learning in business and social sciences**

- Large language models and transformer-based topic modelling for research mapping and text analysis: working knowledge of Python and text mining.
- Network modelling in finance and the social sciences: working knowledge of R or Python and the theory of network models.

**Applied tools**

- Interactive research and teaching applications in R Shiny or Python: experience building and deploying small web applications.

To apply, email [aritra.pan@mse.ac.in](mailto:aritra.pan@mse.ac.in) with your CV and a short note on which of the above you want to work on and why.

## Collaboration

For research or consultancy collaboration, write to the same address.
